turns.text_snippet: That's exactly what I fixed — the Features page at `/features` was showing "Pick a space from the sidebar" with no way to select one. The fix adds a `SpaceFilterDropdown` to that page's toolbar, auto-selects the first space on first visit, and persists the selection in the URL and localStorage. The upgrade was already deployed.
